description: Ministry of Trade Commerce, Food Security, Cooperative Development - Intellectual Property Act. No 36 of 2003 Regulations Made under Section 204 of the Intellectual Property Act. No 36 of 2003
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Intellectual Property Act, No. 36 of 2003. It establishes legal procedures and requirements for the registration of geographical indications, including application processes, examination criteria, publication requirements, opposition procedures, registration certificates, and renewal processes. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for intellectual property matters.
